## Working session summary

Implemented and finalized [PR #2280](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/pull/2280). It is ready for review, mergeable, and all checks pass on exact SHA `bd84aadf`.

Key fixes:

- Release PRs now use an independent `RELEASE_PULL_REQUEST_TOKEN`.
- Validation waits on PR-associated checks with `gh pr checks --watch`; manually dispatched checks cannot satisfy required PR checks per [GitHub’s documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/pull-requests/how-tos/merge-and-close-pull-requests/troubleshooting-required-status-checks).
- Missing credentials fail closed before creating a release branch.
- Permanent policy failures are no longer retried as transient mergeability errors.
- All 35 active Linux jobs are pinned to Ubuntu 24.04 ahead of the announced [Ubuntu 26 migration](https://github.com/actions/runner-images/issues/14748).
- Added reproducing regressions, corrected changeset, documentation updates, and refreshed the stale yargs pin.

Verification:

- 499/499 local test files passed.
- GitHub integration suite: 4/4 passed.
- Final workflows all passed: Checks and release, Security, Workflows, and Broken Link Checker.
